FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
CleanWave Laundry Services specializes in providing high-quality laundry and dry cleaning services, including wash, dry, and fold options, with a focus on customer convenience and satisfaction. Our facility operates with on-site attendants during all hours to ensure a safe and secure environment for our customers. We utilize environmentally-friendly cleaning solutions and modern, well-maintained equipment to minimize our environmental footprint. In addition to traditional laundry services, we offer linen and uniform laundering for various businesses, ensuring adherence to strict sanitation and waste disposal protocols. Our services also include clothing alterations and pressing, providing a comprehensive solution for all our customers' garment care needs. CleanWave is committed to compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations, ensuring our operations are safe and environmentally responsible.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in coin-operated laundries or dry cleaners, industrial laundering, power laundries, or electrotyping, and confirms full compliance with all operational standards. We pride ourselves on adhering to these conditions, ensuring that our services are strictly aligned with permitted activities.
